title: Salted Lassi with Toasted Cumin
summary: A cold, creamy yoghurt drink made savoury with salt and warmed by toasted, crushed cumin seeds.

ingredients.item: plain whole-milk yoghurt (dahi if you can find it)
fine sea salt or table salt, or to taste

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast ½ tsp cumin seeds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for about 1 min until fragrant and a shade darker.

steps.title: Crush
steps.text: Crush half in a mortar and keep the rest whole.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put 480 g plain whole-milk yoghurt, the whole toasted cumin, 1¼ tsp fine salt and 10 ice cubes in the blender.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Start slow and increase speed until smooth and frothy, about 30 s.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Thin with a tablespoon of cold water at a time if you want it looser, and taste for salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into glasses, sprinkle with the crushed cumin and serve straight away.

tips: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan to release their oils and deepen their flavour.
Add cold water gradually to reach your preferred thickness; the ice will melt slightly as you blend.
Serve immediately after blending whilst still frothy and cold.
storage: Drink immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
